channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: 6 Legal Residents, Including Skokie Woman, Detained At O’Hare, Held At ICE Facilities: Officials
item.description: Sundas Naqvi and her five colleagues — all legal residents — were held at two immigration facilities for days before they were released. Little explanation was given for their detention, officials said.

item.title: Hundreds March On Trump Tower For International Women’s Day: ‘We Aren’t Just Fighting For Ourselves’
item.description: Protesters denounced President Trump for his party's limits on abortion access, sweeping immigration raids that have separated families and his inclusion in the Epstein files.

item.title: Hey Friends Cafe Launches Kickstarter To Bring Filipino Food To Portage Park
item.description: Amanda Agosto, who is half Filipino, and her husband hope to open in May in the former Bistro 6050, offering Filipino pastries, tea and more.

item.title: Still Sore Over Budget Battle, Mayor Warns Chicago Could Face Financial Crisis
item.description: At a Lakeview town hall, Mayor Brandon Johnson touted his housing initiatives while outlining how the council-backed alternative budget could create a $163 million shortfall.

item.title: Another LGBTQ+ Boutique Hotel Could Be Coming To Halsted Street In Lakeview
item.description: Plans for the 21-room Tryst Chicago at the former DS Tequila site include a restaurant and rooftop pools. A block south, a six-story hotel catering to LGBTQ+ guests is slated for the former Yoshi’s Cafe.

item.title: 19 Candidates Vying For Jan Schakowsky’s Coveted North Side Congressional Seat
item.description: Schakowsky is retiring after representing Illinois' 9th Congressional District for over 26 years.

item.title: Boxty, The Irish Potato Pancake, Is Hard To Find In Chicago — And It’s Delicious
item.description: This regional Irish specialty, which toes the line between a snack and bread, is a somewhat elusive dish on Chicago restaurant menus.

item.title: 20,000 Pounds Of Corned Beef? This 60-Year-Old South Side Shop Is Ready For St. Paddy’s Day
item.description: County Fair Foods in Morgan Park is known for its fresh corned beef, displayed and sold in bulk right out of the barrel.

item.title: Gourmet Stadium Eats — With Great Views of The Ice — At Blackhawks Expanded Training Facility
item.description: Rocky’s Table & Tap and Raise the Cup Cafe, from chef Paul Kahan and One Off Hospitality, recently opened to the public at the team’s training facility on the Near West Side.

item.title: Logan Square Arts Fest Returning This Summer After Skipping A Year Due To Construction
item.description: With a bigger, renovated plaza, the festival will be able to expand its vendor marketplace to feature double the amount of local makers and artists.
